# Pull request

## What changed

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Type of change

- [ ] Add a resource with an accepted nomination
- [ ] Repair or update a link
- [ ] Remove an unavailable or unsuitable resource
- [ ] Improve a description or category
- [ ] Change repository policy or maintenance files

## Related issue

Link the accepted resource nomination or maintenance issue when one exists.

## Checks

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I kept this pull request focused.
- [ ] I searched for duplicate entries and earlier proposals.
- [ ] I used an official, stable URL when possible.
- [ ] I checked every changed link.
- [ ] I used the required entry format.
- [ ] I disclosed any personal or financial connection.
- [ ] I checked spelling, grammar, and Markdown formatting.
